board.title: Getting started with fvoci
board.description: One card for each thing fvoci does. Open a card to read it, and move it to “Done it” once you have tried it. Delete this board when you are through.

content.text: What you are reading is a card. One task, one topic or one customer of a board is one card.
The title and the icon
are at the top. Press them to change them.
The properties
come next. This card has a progress, a topic and a day.
The body
is where this text is. Write as much as you like.
Comments
go at the bottom.
Try it
Set this card's Progress to “Done it”
Leave a comment below
Close the card and drag it to another column of the board

cards.title: See the same cards five ways

content.text: The tabs at the top of a board are its views. Changing the view changes how the cards are shown, never the cards. This board has all five: press each one.

attrs.alt: A board of three columns with cards in them

content.text: Board
: columns by one property, and cards you drag between them.
Table
: a row for each card, a column for each property, and sums or averages below.
Gallery
: the first picture of a body becomes the face of its card.
Calendar
: cards placed by a date property.
Gantt
: a bar for each period, and lines from the cards that have to end first.

attrs.alt: A Gantt chart of bars that follow one another

content.text: A property is a field that every card of the board has. Open a card and press “+ Add a property” below its properties to choose a kind.
Text, number, email, phone and URL
Select and multi select, with a color for each option
Date: one day, or a period
Person: somebody, such as who is in charge
Checkbox
Who made or last changed a card, and when: filled in for you
Card relation: other cards of the same board. “Read first” on this board is one
The other templates show them at work: Customer contacts has email and phone, Issue tracker has who made a card and when it last changed.
Each view decides for itself what it shows and in what order, with the buttons beside its name.
Filter
: keeps the cards that meet your conditions, all of them or any of them.
Sort
: puts the cards in the order of a property.
Group by
: the property that makes the columns of a board and the groups of a table or a Gantt chart. Hide the columns you do not need.
Properties
: the properties shown on the face of a card.
The Table view of this board is sorted by day and has a sum below its Minutes column.
Press
on an empty line to see the blocks you can put in. Everything below is such a block, in this very body.
Headings come in three sizes
Text

bold

or
as code
Shift and Enter start a new line without a new paragraph.
A quotation is set off like this.
A callout sets a note apart. Press its icon to make it a note, a tip, a warning or a danger.
A toggle folds away what is under it
Press the arrow to open or close it. Each person opens and closes it for themselves.

A bulleted list

Pointing at another card
A body can point at a card or a wiki page:
Press it and the card opens.

cards.title: Attach files and open them right here

content.text: Drop a file into a body: a picture is shown as a picture, any other file as a block with its name. Press the name of the file below.
It opens in the browser, with nothing to download. These kinds of file open this way:
PDF
Word documents (DOCX)
Excel workbooks (XLSX)
PowerPoint decks (PPTX)
Hangul documents (HWP, HWPX)
A file of any other kind is downloaded.

cards.title: Keep your documents in a wiki

content.text: A board divides work into cards; a wiki gathers writing into pages. It suits what is read for a long time: how we work, the rules of a meeting, what the product does.
Pages go below pages, as a tree.
The body of a page is the body of a card: lists, code, formulas, pictures and files all go in.
A body can point at other pages and at cards.
A deleted page comes back from the wiki's trash.
Try it
Press “Add board or wiki” in the sidebar and choose “New wiki”
Give the first page a title and make another page below it

cards.title: Start a board from a template

content.text: “Add board or wiki” in the sidebar offers an empty board and the templates. Each template shows another side of fvoci.
Project schedule
: the Gantt view, and tasks that wait for others
Issue tracker
: filters, hidden columns and properties that fill themselves in
Meeting notes
: a card template, and the calendar
Content calendar
: the gallery and the calendar
Customer contacts
: the table and its calculations
Study notes
: formulas, code and diagrams
A board of your own can be made into a template too, from its menu in the sidebar.
Boards and wikis are shared. Several people can write in the same body at once and see each other's words as they come.
On each board a person has a role: admin, editor, commenter or viewer.
Press
in a body and pick a name to point at somebody.
Somebody who should see one board or one wiki and nothing else is invited as a guest, where an administrator has turned guests on.
You are alone on this board. Open “Share” at the top of the board to add people.

cards.title: Learn step by step in a course

content.text: Create a Course from the sidebar to structure onboarding lessons or shared study plans into chapters and units, track completion, schedule meetings, and leave unit questions.
Press ⌘K (or Ctrl+K) from anywhere to search cards, wiki pages and course units across the workspace and jump straight to them.

cards.title: Stay on top of Today and notifications

content.text: Open “Today” in the sidebar to see due cards, course units, reviews and upcoming meetings across your spaces, and check the notification bell whenever someone mentions or assigns you.
